_doc: Main agent with OSFP (arXiv 2303.05197 App. VII-4 Alg. 1, Table IV; arXiv 2303.04096 Eq. 6/16): self-play 0.6, else history with the newest snapshot weighted 1+optimism=2; the learner joins the history at the end of a learning period if its period score G/C > xi vs every historical model, or after max_periods periods. period_samples = 10 updates x 16384 decisions. snapshot_every is ignored (OSFP decides).
